persona: Bright, playful comic-book narrator with comic timing

lines.text: Every page has a hero. This is not him.
Smudge was the mistake nobody erased in time.
But mistakes are very good at filling gaps.
Heroes save the story. Somebody has to hold it together.
Turn the page. He's still there.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
